name: Eliana Glass + Anne Paceo + Mammal Hands
description: This concert features Eliana Glass, Anne Paceo, and Mammal Hands as part of the Misty Fest. Eliana Glass performs intimate romantic ballads, Anne Paceo presents her eighth album, Atlantis, and Mammal Hands showcases their latest album, Circada.
longDescription:
The Casa da Música hosts a concert featuring Eliana Glass, Anne Paceo, and Mammal Hands on November 30, 2026, at 8:00 PM in Sala Suggia. This event is part of the Misty Fest, focusing on contemporary jazz nights.

Eliana Glass, a singer, pianist, and visual artist, performs intimate and minimalist romantic ballads. French drummer and composer Anne Paceo presents her eighth album, Atlantis, inspired by the ocean, alongside Maya Cros, Lilian Mille, Gauthier Toux, Christophe Panzani, and Cynthia Abraham. Mammal Hands, a trio from Norwich, combines jazz, contemporary classical, electronic, folk, and minimalism, performing their latest album, Circada.

Tickets for the concert range from €20.00 to €40.00. The event is suitable for ages 6 and above. The venue, Casa da Música, is located at Avenida da Boavista, 604-610, 4149-071 Porto.

longDescriptionPt:

Eliana Glass, cantora, pianista e artista visual, interpreta baladas românticas intimistas e minimalistas. A baterista e compositora francesa Anne Paceo apresenta o seu oitavo álbum, Atlantis, inspirado no oceano, ao lado de Maya Cros, Lilian Mille, Gauthier Toux, Christophe Panzani e Cynthia Abraham. Mammal Hands, um trio de Norwich, combina jazz, música clássica contemporânea, eletrónica, folk e minimalismo, apresentando o seu mais recente álbum, Circada.

Os bilhetes para o concerto variam entre 20,00 € e 40,00 €. O evento é adequado para maiores de 6 anos. A Casa da Música fica na Avenida da Boavista, 604-610, 4149-071 Porto.
